searchText: MSRP $120,446. New Brinkley 5th Wheel for sale - 2026 Brinkley Model Z 2700 is approximately 29' 11' in length with 3 slides. Features Dual Pane Windows Curt TCS Upgraded Suspension Integrity Package Power Package Insulation Package Fireplace Dual Awnings More About This RV Featuring a spacious L-sofa with four recliners and a 65' articulating TV for endless entertainment, this fifth wheel is a great option to get on the road! The convertible dining table/L desk seats up to four people, making it perfect for meals, work, or play. You can cozy up by the fireplace and enjoy quality time with loved ones. Plus, ample shoe storage keeps your gear organized. The kitchen is equipped with solid surface countertops, dishwasher prep, a residential microwave, and a three-burner cooktop. Also, the large pantry with pull-out drawers provides ample storage for your favorite ingredients and cooking essentials. The one-piece fiberglass shower is a highlight of the bathroom, offering a convenient space to get ready, and additional storage is provided by the linen closet. And you will love the front main bedroom featuring a residential queen memory foam mattress with nightstands, outlets, and USB & USB-C ports for convenient charging. The Brinkley mid-profile Model Z fifth wheels bring you clean lines and an upscale look with plenty of style and exciting new features like the industry first brass plumbing connections. These units also feature an automotive grade front cap, plenty of exterior storage, exterior hot and cold showers, and wide stance leveling jacks for easy set up. Residential frameless windows provide a clean look and beautiful views, and ample electrical outlets and 6 USB/USB-C outlets allow all of your electronics and appliances to easily be used and charged.
